summary: Implemented DatabricksOauthProfileMapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py (login = OAuth client ID, password = client secret, secret emitted as COSMOS_CONN_DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET env var, auth_type: oauth; claims only connections with a login). Exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and registered it in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py before the token mapping. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py. Tests were not run, per instructions. Docs and changelog were not updated. Nothing committed.
